assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original editorial hero photograph for moongtsun, an Apple Watch health-data app bringing activity, recovery and readiness together. Primary request: show gentle everyday movement at the transition from night to morning, suggesting balance between activity and rest. Scene: a quiet curving footpath through soft coastal grass and rolling dunes at dawn, a distant solitary adult walking away from the camera in simple unbranded outdoor clothing. Natural pale sky, subtle first sunlight, a calm sea glimpsed in the distance. Style: refined editorial nature photography, realistic grass and sand texture, atmospheric but grounded, a hint of fine photographic grain. Composition: portrait 4:5, expansive landscape and winding trail, person small in the middle distance, graceful open sky across upper quarter, useful crop margins. Color: muted sage greens, warm cream sand, softly cool blue sky, no artificial saturated color. Constraints: no text, no logo, no watermark, no phones, no watches, no UI, no health values or charts, no claims about actual product screens. The image supports a thoughtful review of movement, sleep and daily condition.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original supporting editorial photograph for moongtsun, an Apple Watch health-data app that puts movement, sleep and readiness in context. Style: refined grounded editorial photography with realistic natural texture, soft photographic grain. Composition: wide landscape 3:2, lake across the lower two thirds, gentle horizontal bands and quiet open space; no buildings or people. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no devices, no UI, no charts, no promotional copy.
